checks.message: Load balancer deletion immediately drops all traffic — update DNS first
checks.context: All registered instances stop receiving traffic immediately. Any DNS records (CNAME or Alias) pointing to this load balancer will resolve to nothing. Update DNS before deleting.

checks.message: Deleting a listener immediately stops traffic on that port
checks.context: If this is the HTTPS listener (port 443), all secure traffic stops. If it's the only listener, the load balancer accepts no traffic at all. Verify before removing.

checks.message: Verify the instance's security group allows traffic from the load balancer
checks.context: Registering an instance doesn't automatically configure security groups. The instance must allow inbound traffic from the load balancer's security group on the listener port, or health checks will fail.
